description: This file is a shell script (.sh) for generating U-Boot FIT image source files (.its). It includes functions for creating image and configuration nodes, handling multiple images and configurations, and supporting features like signatures, hashes, and compression. The script processes command-line arguments and outputs a structured .its file. It is used as part of the build process for embedded Linux firmware images.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and command-line options for the script.

methods.name: array_check
methods.description: Verifies if an array index is within valid bounds.

methods.name: array_put
methods.description: Sets a value in the specified array at a given index, optionally appending.

methods.name: array_get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the specified array at a given index.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to configure image and configuration parameters.

methods.name: value_sanity_chk
methods.description: Validates signature, hash, and compression options.

methods.name: emit_its
methods.description: Outputs sections of the .its file, including headers, images, configurations, and section end.

methods.name: emit_kernel
methods.description: Generates a kernel node with associated properties.

methods.name: emit_fdt
methods.description: Generates a flattened device tree (FDT) node configuration.

methods.name: emit_ramdisk
methods.description: Generates a ramdisk node in the .its file.

methods.name: emit_signature
methods.description: Outputs signature nodes for image components.

methods.name: emit_config
methods.description: Creates a configuration node for a specific image setup.

methods.name: emit_image_nodes
methods.description: Generates all image nodes (kernel, fdt, ramdisk) and their subnodes.
